title: triggerFactor unset-default of 0 means inject-on-any-drawdown (inverted-safe default)
root_cause: The off sentinel is type(uint256).max but the unset DataStore default is 0, which means inject on any drawdown>0. A fee-collecting market whose insuranceFundDrawdownTriggerFactor isn't set to max auto-drains its reserve on the slightest realized drawdown.
attacker_capabilities: config admin leaves triggerFactor unset on a fee-collecting market

severity_justification.worst_case: A misconfigured market silently auto-drains its insurance reserve.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: 0xMarkets contest (0xMarkets_contract-main @ e94daee); GMX Synthetics fork (ships GMX audits).

call_trace: any realized drawdown > 0 triggers injection -> reserve drained
asset_delta: Insurance reserve silently drained into the pool for a misconfigured market (bounded by reserve).
reproduction_steps: code analysis — see report.md + vulnerable/ source (no standalone PoC: standalone PoC needs the full GMX build (@openzeppelin-v4 + MarketUtils/DataStore deps); code-verified config finding.)
prior_audit_overlap: GMX core is audited (ABDK/Certora/Dedaub/Guardian); this is the 0xMarkets delta / a GMX-inherited fact
invalidating_conditions: standalone PoC needs the full GMX build (@openzeppelin-v4 + MarketUtils/DataStore deps); code-verified config finding.

defense_analysis.defense: deploy-script sets triggerFactor=max for non-onboarded markets
defense_analysis.why_it_fails: relies on operator discipline; the on-chain default is fail-open

assumptions: GMX Synthetics fork; insurance module is the 0xMarkets delta
